records.jp: せっかくだから、参拝してこっか！
records.en_original: Wanna say a prayer while we're here?
records.en_auxiliary: Wanna say a prayer while we're here?
records.en: Since we're here, why don't we pay our respects?

records.jp: うん。愛央がしたいなら、してく
records.en_original: If you'd like to, that's fine with me.
records.en_auxiliary: If you'd like to, that's fine with me.
records.en: Yes. If Ao wants to, Kirara will too.

records.jp: よーし！<CR>じゃあさっそく、鈴を鳴らしてっと……
records.en_original: Cool! Right, first up, let's ring this bell...
records.en_auxiliary: Cool! Right, first up, let's ring this bell...
records.en: All right!<CR>Then first, I'll ring the bell...

records.jp: 愛央。神様がびっくりする
records.en_original: Ao, you'll frighten the gods.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, you'll frighten the gods.
records.en: Ao, you'll frighten the gods.

records.jp: えっ、なんで？
records.en_original: Huh? Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why?
records.en: Huh? Why?

records.jp: いきなり鈴緒を鳴らすのは、<CR>アポなし訪問と同じ
records.en_original: Ringing the bell right away is like barging into someone's house without knocking.
records.en_auxiliary: Ringing the bell right away is like barging into someone's house without knocking.
records.en: Ringing the bell rope without warning is the same as making an unannounced<CR>visit.

records.jp: 道場破りだって、たのもーって言いながら<CR>ドア、突き破ってくる
records.en_original: You don't go to the doctor without making an appointment first, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't go to the doctor without making an appointment first, right?
records.en: Even someone challenging a dojo breaks through the door<CR>while shouting, 'I challenge you!'

records.jp: そっか、なるほど。<CR>つまり……
records.en_original: Oh, okay... So that means...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, okay... So that means...
records.en: Oh, okay...<CR>So that means...

records.jp: 挨拶が先ってことだね！
records.en_original: I just need to introduce myself first!
records.en_auxiliary: I just need to introduce myself first!
records.en: Right! Kirara should introduce herself first!

records.jp: そう。まずはお辞儀から。<CR>はい、ぺこりー
records.en_original: Precisely. First, you have to bow. Like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Precisely. First, you have to bow. Like this.
records.en: Right. First, bow.<CR>There, pekorii.

records.jp: ぺこりー！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Pekorii!

records.jp: 神様にもアポが必要なんだね
records.en_original: I didn't know I had to introduce myself to the gods.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't know I had to introduce myself to the gods.
records.en: Even gods need appointments, huh.

records.jp: アポっていうか、来たことを報せる。<CR>神様も忙しいから
records.en_original: The gods are quite busy, you have to let them know you're here first.
records.en_auxiliary: The gods are quite busy, you have to let them know you're here first.
records.en: Not exactly an appointment. You let them know you have come.<CR>Gods are busy too.

records.jp: たしかに……<CR>色んな人のお願い、聞いて回ってそうだもんなー
records.en_original: That makes sense... I bet they have to hear a whole lot of prayers.
records.en_auxiliary: That makes sense... I bet they have to hear a whole lot of prayers.
records.en: That makes sense...<CR>I bet they have to hear a whole lot of prayers.

records.jp: うん。だから、まずは挨拶
records.en_original: Yes. So, go ahead and introduce yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. So, go ahead and introduce yourself.
records.en: Yes. So, go ahead and introduce yourself.

records.jp: わかった！<CR>んじゃ、神様こんにちはーっと！
records.en_original: Okay! Here we go. Hello, gods!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay! Here we go. Hello, gods!
records.en: Got it!<CR>Then, hello, gods!

records.jp: そしたら、次は……
records.en_original: And next is...
records.en_auxiliary: And next is...
records.en: And next is...

records.jp: ……いよっし！　お願い終わり！
records.en_original: ...Whew, all done!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Whew, all done!
records.en: ...Whew, all done!

records.jp: きららのおかげで、ちゃんと神様に<CR>願いが届いたような気がするよ
records.en_original: Thanks, Kirara. I really feel like the gods heard my prayer.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Kirara. I really feel like the gods heard my prayer.
records.en: Thanks to you, Kirara,<CR>I feel like my wish properly reached the gods.

records.jp: 役に立てたならよかった
records.en_original: I'm happy to be of help.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm happy to be of help.
records.en: I'm happy to be of help.

records.jp: でも、こんなことまで知ってるなんてさ……
records.en_original: You really sure know a lot, don't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You really sure know a lot, don't you?
records.en: But knowing even something like this...

records.jp: きららって、すごいね
records.en_original: You're amazing, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: You're amazing, Kirara.
records.en: You're amazing, Kirara.

records.jp: 別にすごくない。<CR>ただ、知ってただけ
records.en_original: That's not true. I just happened to know.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true. I just happened to know.
records.en: Kirara is not amazing.<CR>She only knew it.

records.jp: それが、すごいんじゃん！
records.en_original: But that's what's amazing!
records.en_auxiliary: But that's what's amazing!
records.en: But that's what's amazing!

records.jp: こういう知識が、サラッと出てくる人って<CR>なんかカッコイイよ！
records.en_original: I think people that can just pull out random facts are super cool.
records.en_auxiliary: I think people that can just pull out random facts are super cool.
records.en: People who can casually bring out knowledge like<CR>this seem really cool!

records.jp: カッコイイ……
records.en_original: You think I'm cool...?
records.en_auxiliary: You think I'm cool...?
records.en: You think I'm cool...?

records.jp: そうか……<CR>きららはカッコイイのか
records.en_original: I see... I'm cool...
records.en_auxiliary: I see... I'm cool...
records.en: I see...<CR>Kirara is cool.

records.jp: きららって、勉強家なんだね
records.en_original: You must study a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: You must study a lot.
records.en: You must study a lot.

records.jp: 勉強してない。前に他の神様のことが気になって<CR>調べたことがあるだけ
records.en_original: Not at all. I was simply curious about other gods, so I researched it. That's it.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. I was simply curious about other gods, so I researched it. That's it.
records.en: Kirara did not study. She once became curious about other gods<CR>and looked them up, that is all.

records.jp: でも、それを今も覚えてるんでしょ？<CR>私だったら、忘れちゃうよ
records.en_original: But you still remember it all though, right? I would've forgotten everything right away!
records.en_auxiliary: But you still remember it all though, right? I would've forgotten everything right away!
records.en: But you still remember it now, right?<CR>I'd forget it.

records.jp: ……今日のことも、忘れる？
records.en_original: ...Are you going to forget what we did today too?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Are you going to forget what we did today too?
records.en: ...Are you going to forget what we did today too?

records.jp: まっさか！　きららが教えてくれたからね。<CR>次からはちゃんと参拝するし！
records.en_original: Of course not! You took the time to teach me, after all. I'll be sure to do this whenever I go to a shrine!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not! You took the time to teach me, after all. I'll be sure to do this whenever I go to a shrine!
records.en: No way! You taught me, Kirara.<CR>I'll pay my respects properly from now on!

records.jp: うん。それがいいと思う
records.en_original: Good. I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: Good. I'm glad.
records.en: Yes. Kirara thinks that is good.

records.jp: ……あれ？<CR>きららは何かお願いしないの？
records.en_original: Huh? Are you not going to make a wish too, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Are you not going to make a wish too, Kirara?
records.en: Huh? Are you<CR>not going to make a wish too, Kirara?

records.jp: きららの場合神様の声が聞こえるから、<CR>聞こえてるそばでお願いするのは抵抗がある
records.en_original: I can already hear the Divine. I think it would be rude to wish for things on top of that.
records.en_auxiliary: I can already hear the Divine. I think it would be rude to wish for things on top of that.
records.en: In Kirara's case, she can hear the Divine's voice,<CR>so making a wish while the Divine listens beside her feels awkward.

records.jp: あー、確かに……。目の前で聞かれてるって思うと<CR>ちょっと恥ずかしいかも
records.en_original: Ahh, I guess it would be kinda weird when you can already talk directly with the Divine whenever you want.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, I guess it would be kinda weird when you can already talk directly with the Divine whenever you want.
records.en: Ah, that makes sense... It might be a little embarrassing<CR>if you knew they were listening right in front of you.

records.jp: でも、今はその声聞こえないんだよね？<CR>だったら参拝初体験のチャンスじゃない？
records.en_original: But you can't hear their voice now, right? Isn't this a chance to give it a go?
records.en_auxiliary: But you can't hear their voice now, right? Isn't this a chance to give it a go?
records.en: But you can't hear that voice now, right?<CR>Isn't this your chance to pay your respects for the first time?

records.jp: ……おお。じゃあ、ちょっとやってみる<CR>
records.en_original: ...You may be right. I suppose I could give it a try.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You may be right. I suppose I could give it a try.
records.en: ...Oh. Then Kirara will try it.<CR>

records.jp: むう。いざ願い事をするとなると難しい……。<CR>どういうことを願えばいい……？
records.en_original: Hm... This is more difficult than I thought. What do I wish for?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... This is more difficult than I thought. What do I wish for?
records.en: Hm. It becomes difficult when Kirara actually has to make a wish...<CR>What should she wish for?

records.jp: そうだなあ……
records.en_original: Let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see...
records.en: Let's see...

records.jp: 個人的な願い事でもいいんじゃない？<CR>痩せたいーとか、頭が良くなりたいーとか
records.en_original: Just wish for whatever you want! Like, "Help me lose weight!", or "Make me smarter!"
records.en_auxiliary: Just wish for whatever you want! Like, "Help me lose weight!", or "Make me smarter!"
records.en: Why not make a personal wish?<CR>Like wanting to lose weight or become smarter.

records.jp: 小さな願い事の方が、叶えてもらえそうだし
records.en_original: Feels like small things like that are more likely to get granted anyways.
records.en_auxiliary: Feels like small things like that are more likely to get granted anyways.
records.en: A small wish seems more likely to be granted too.

records.jp: なるほど。<CR>手間をかけさせないの、大事
records.en_original: I see. I suppose it's a good thing to not ask for too much.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. I suppose it's a good thing to not ask for too much.
records.en: I see.<CR>It's important not to make extra work for them.

records.jp: ……ないすばでーになりたい、<CR>ないすばでーになりたい
records.en_original: Please grant me a sexier body... Please grant me a sexier body...
records.en_auxiliary: Please grant me a sexier body... Please grant me a sexier body...
records.en: ...Kirara wants a nice body.<CR>Kirara wants a nice body.

records.jp: （……そんな風に思ってたんだ。<CR>今のきららのままで十分魅力的だと思うけどなあ）
records.en_original: (I'm surprised she feels that way... Kirara's beautiful enough as she is, if you ask me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm surprised she feels that way... Kirara's beautiful enough as she is, if you ask me.)
records.en: (...So she thinks that way.<CR>I think Kirara is attractive enough just as she is.)

records.jp: まわりのことを願うとか、どうかな。<CR>よく世界平和を願う人とかもいるし
records.en_original: How about something for the good of humanity? Like world peace!
records.en_auxiliary: How about something for the good of humanity? Like world peace!
records.en: How about wishing for the people around you?<CR>Some people wish for world peace.

records.jp: なるほど
records.en_original: That makes sense...
records.en_auxiliary: That makes sense...
records.en: That makes sense...

records.jp: ……この世界のみんなが、幸せになれますように
records.en_original: ...Please bring peace to everyone across the world...
records.en_auxiliary: ...Please bring peace to everyone across the world...
records.en: ...May everyone in this world be happy.

records.jp: ……うん。叶えたいね
records.en_original: I hope it comes true.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope it comes true.
records.en: ...Yeah. Let's make it come true.

records.jp: 叶えよう。きららたちで
records.en_original: It will. We'll make it come true.
records.en_auxiliary: It will. We'll make it come true.
records.en: Kirara and the others will make it come true.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
